purpose: `ColorPicker` provides client-side HSV color controls built with Blend. The package creates its own GUI, supports mouse and touch dragging, exposes the selected color as both `Color3` and HSV, and automatically chooses contrasting cursor colors.
description: `ColorPicker` provides client-side HSV color controls built with Blend. The package creates its own GUI, supports mouse and touch dragging, exposes the selected color as both `Color3` and HSV, and automatically chooses contrasting cursor colors.

Client/ColorPickerUtils.luau.description: Color-picker presentation utilities. Public entry points include `ColorPickerUtils.getOutlineWithContrast`.

Client/Cursor/ColorPickerCursorPreview.l.description: Floating selected-color preview, primarily for touch input where a finger can occlude the picker. Public entry points include `ColorPickerCursorPreview.new`, `ColorPickerCursorPreview.HintBackgroundColor`, `ColorPickerCursorPreview.SetPosition`, `ColorPickerCursorPreview.GetPosition`, `ColorPickerCursorPreview.SetColor`, `ColorPickerCursorPreview.SetTransparency`.

Client/Cursor/ColorPickerTriangle.luau.description: Contrast-aware triangular marker used by value pickers. Public entry points include `ColorPickerTriangle.new`, `ColorPickerTriangle.HintBackgroundColor`, `ColorPickerTriangle.GetSizeValue`, `ColorPickerTriangle.GetMeasureValue`, `ColorPickerTriangle.SetColor`, `ColorPickerTriangle.SetTransparency`.

Client/Cursor/HSColorPickerCursor.luau.description: Crosshair cursor used by HSColorPicker. Public entry points include `HSColorPickerCursor.new`, `HSColorPickerCursor.HintBackgroundColor`, `HSColorPickerCursor.SetVerticalHairVisible`, `HSColorPickerCursor.SetHorizontalHairVisible`, `HSColorPickerCursor.SetHeight`, `HSColorPickerCursor.SetPosition`, `HSColorPickerCursor.GetPosition`, `HSColorPickerCursor.SetTransparency`.

Client/HSV/HSColorPicker.luau.description: Selects hue and saturation in HSV color space. Use [HSVColorPicker] when value selection is also required. Public entry points include `HSColorPicker.new`, `HSColorPicker.ObserveIsPressed`, `HSColorPicker.SetHSVColor`, `HSColorPicker.GetHSVColor`, `HSColorPicker.SetColor`, `HSColorPicker.GetColor`, `HSColorPicker.GetSizeValue`, `HSColorPicker.GetMeasureValue`.

Client/HSV/HSVColorPicker.luau.description: A complete HSV color picker with hue, saturation, and value controls. Public entry points include `HSVColorPicker.new`, `HSVColorPicker.SetSize`, `HSVColorPicker.SyncValue`, `HSVColorPicker.HintBackgroundColor`, `HSVColorPicker.SetHSVColor`, `HSVColorPicker.GetHSVColor`, `HSVColorPicker.SetColor`, `HSVColorPicker.GetColor`.

Client/HSV/ValueColorPicker.luau.description: Selects the value component of an HSV color. Public entry points include `ValueColorPicker.new`, `ValueColorPicker.SetSize`, `ValueColorPicker.HintBackgroundColor`, `ValueColorPicker.ObserveIsPressed`, `ValueColorPicker.SetHSVColor`, `ValueColorPicker.GetHSVColor`, `ValueColorPicker.SetColor`, `ValueColorPicker.GetColor`.
